summary: Woori Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting an internal asset revaluation of land properties under K-IFRS. It revalued 318 parcels as of March 31, 2026, increasing asset book value from KRW 1,779.9 billion to KRW 4,248.4 billion (KRW 2,468.5 billion difference), with a provisional equity increase of KRW 1,791.9 billion via revaluation surplus. This is a routine accounting update with no acquisition, divestiture, or structural change. No deal terms, premium, or regulatory clock apply. Watch for audit finalization; no risk-arb angle.
